description_en: Describes ApsaraDB for ClickHouse clusters in a specified region
description_zh: 查询云数据库ClickHouse指定地域的集群信息
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse describe-db-clusters --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-ids cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --db-cluster-description cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --db-cluster-status Running --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --tag Value=it Key=department --resource-group-id rg-4690g379290000 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBClusters

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

If you do not specify this parameter, information about all clusters is queried by default
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
不配置该参数时，默认查询所有集群的信息
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The state of the cluster. Valid values:

Preparing: The cluster is being prepared.

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.

SCALING_OUT: The cluster is being scaled out
parameters.help_zh:
集群状态，取值说明：
Preparing：准备中。
Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Deleting：删除中。
SCALING_OUT：扩容中
parameters.name: db_cluster_status

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page. Valid values:

30 (Default)

50

100
parameters.help_zh:
每页记录数，取值：
30（默认值）
50
100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the cluster belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

Bid.description_en:
The site ID. Valid values:

26842: Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com).

26888: Alibaba Cloud International Website (www.alibabacloud.com)
Bid.description_zh:
站点ID，取值说明：

26842：中国站。
26888：国际站

Category.description_en:
The edition of the cluster. Valid values:

Basic: Single-replica Edition.

HighAvailability: Dual-replica Edition
Category.description_zh:
副本配置，取值说明：
Basic：单副本版。
HighAvailability：双副本版

ControlVersion.description_en:
The version of the backend management system. Valid values:

v1

v2
ControlVersion.description_zh:
后台管控系统版本号，取值说明：

v1

v2

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the cluster was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format

DBClusterNetworkType.description_en: The network type. Only VPC is supported

DBClusterStatus.description_en:
The state of the cluster. Valid values:

Preparing: The cluster is being prepared.

Creating: The cluster is being created.

Running: The cluster is running.

Deleting: The cluster is being deleted.

SCALING_OUT: The cluster is being scaled out
DBClusterStatus.description_zh:
集群状态，取值说明：
Preparing：准备中。
Creating：创建中。
Running：运行中。

SCALING_OUT：扩容中

DBNodeClass.description_en:
The instance type of the cluster.<props="china"></props>

For single-replica edition clusters, valid values are:

LS20: Large storage, 20 cores, 88 GB memory.

LS40: Large storage, 40 cores, 176 GB memory.

LS80: Large storage, 80 cores, 352 GB memory.

S8: Standard, 8 cores, 32 GB memory.

S16: Standard, 16 cores, 64 GB memory.

S32: Standard, 32 cores, 128 GB memory.

S64: Standard, 64 cores, 256 GB memory.

S80: Standard, 80 cores, 384 GB memory.

S104: Standard, 104 cores, 384 GB memory.

For dual-replica edition clusters, valid values are:

LC20: Large storage, 20 cores, 88 GB memory.

LC40: Large storage, 40 cores, 176 GB memory.

LC80: Large storage, 80 cores, 352 GB memory.

C8: Standard, 8 cores, 32 GB memory.

C16: Standard, 16 cores, 64 GB memory.

C32: Standard, 32 cores, 128 GB memory.

C64: Standard, 64 cores, 256 GB memory.

C80: Standard, 80 cores, 384 GB memory.

C104: Standard, 104 cores, 384 GB memory.

<props="intl">

For single-replica edition clusters, valid values are:
  - S4: 4 cores, 16 GB memory.
  - S8: 8 cores, 32 GB memory.

S16: 16 cores, 64 GB memory.

S32: 32 cores, 128 GB memory.

S64 : 64 cores, 256 GB memory.

S104: 104 cores, 384 GB memory.

For dual-replica edition clusters, valid values are:
  - C4: 4 cores, 16 GB memory.
  - C8: 8 cores, 32 GB memory.
  - C16: 16 cores, 64 GB memory.
  - C32: 32 cores, 128 GB memory.
  - C64 : 64 cores, 256 GB memory.
  - C104: 104 cores, 384 GB memory.

</props>

DBNodeCount.description_en:
The number of nodes.

For a single-replica edition cluster, the value is from 1 to 48.

For a dual-replica edition cluster, the value is from 1 to 24
DBNodeCount.description_zh:
节点数量。
单副本版，取值范围：1~48。
双副本版，取值范围：1~24

DBNodeStorage.description_en:
The storage space of a single node. The value ranges from 100 GB to 32,000 GB.

The step size is 100 GB
DBNodeStorage.description_zh:
单节点存储空间，取值范围：100 GB~32000 GB。

步长为100 GB

DbVersion.description_en: The kernel version of the cluster

ExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration time of the cluster. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format.

Pay-as-you-go clusters do not expire. This parameter is empty for pay-as-you-go clusters
ExpireTime.description_zh:
集群的到期时间，格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
按量付费集群无到期时间，返回值为空

ExtStorageType.description_en:
The extended storage class. Valid values:

CloudSSD: standard SSD.

CloudESSD: ESSD PL1.

CloudESSD_PL2: ESSD PL2.

CloudESSD_PL3: ESSD PL3.

CloudEfficiency: ultra disk
ExtStorageType.description_zh:
扩展存储类型，取值说明：
CloudSSD：SSD云盘。
CloudESSD：ESSD PL1云盘。
CloudESSD_PL2：ESSD PL2云盘。
CloudESSD_PL3：ESSD PL3云盘。
CloudEfficiency：高效云盘

IsExpired.description_en:
Indicates whether the cluster has expired. Valid values:

true: The cluster has expired.

false: The cluster has not expired
IsExpired.description_zh:
集群是否过期，取值说明：
true：集群已过期。
false：集群未过期

LockMode.description_en:
The lock mode of the cluster. Valid values:

Unlock: The cluster is not locked.

ManualLock: The cluster is manually locked.

LockByExpiration: The cluster is automatically locked upon expiration.

LockByRestoration: The cluster is automatically locked before a rollback.

LockByDiskQuota: The cluster is automatically locked because the disk is full
LockMode.description_zh:
集群的锁定模式，取值说明：
Unlock：正常。
ManualLock：手动触发锁定。
LockByExpiration：集群过期自动锁定。 
LockByRestoration：集群回滚前的自动锁定。
LockByDiskQuota：集群空间满自动锁定

LockReason.description_en:
The reason why the cluster was locked.

This parameter is empty if the cluster is not locked
LockReason.description_zh:
锁定原因。
锁定模式为Unlock时，返回值为空

PayType.description_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go.

Prepaid: subscription
PayType.description_zh:
付费类型，取值说明：
Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the cluster belongs

ScaleOutDisableWriteWindows.description_en: The write-blocking window for the upgrade or downgrade

Progress.description_en:
The data migration progress in percentage.

This parameter is returned only when the cluster is in the SCALING_OUT state
Progress.description_zh:
数据搬迁百分比。
仅集群状态为SCALING_OUT时，返回该参数

Ratio.description_en:
The data migration progress. The format is \`Data migrated/Total data\`.

This parameter is returned only when the cluster is in the SCALING_OUT state
Ratio.description_zh:
数据搬迁的进度，格式：已搬迁数据量/数据总量。
仅集群状态为SCALING_OUT时，返回该参数
